methodology.alignment: A single deterministic sub-sample latency per decoder and DSD rate is estimated from A002 by parabolic peak interpolation, then compensated with cubic Lagrange interpolation.
methodology.gain: Least-squares projection of aligned decoded PCM onto the DXD master.
methodology.snr: RMS master divided by RMS gain-normalized reconstruction error.
methodology.thdn: 20 Hz to 20 kHz residual after least-squares removal of known sine fundamental and DC.
methodology.spectra: 50%-overlapped Hann-window Welch power spectra, stereo channels averaged.
methodology.group_delay: Phase derivative of the normalized A002 impulse response with negative-time samples placed at the end of the FFT buffer.
